text: I recently used this clinic for my first time for teeth cleaning and fillings. I was able to get a 900 baht discount from my social security insurance. The dentist provided excellent service and advice. They explained all the hidden costs and excess charges to put my mind at ease. The total cost for both cleaning and fillings was 3,500 baht, with only 1,100 baht exceeding the initial cost. It was very affordable and worthwhile. Plus, I didn't have to go through the hassle of submitting documents to social security. It was very convenient for both parties. I recommend checking them out. (This is my true experience, not a biased endorsement of this clinic)...
